description: ai-ecoverse/slicc-jsh#538: child_process.fork's send(message, handle) with a handle that can't be sent: ERR_INVALID_HANDLE_TYPE for what is not a socket or a server; an unconnected or destroyed socket, and a server not listening or closed, send the message alone; a TLSSocket goes with no descriptor, the child refuses it (NODE_HANDLE_NACK) and the parent's resend throws ERR_INVALID_HANDLE_TYPE, as in Node
